answer: Sybil resistance binds each agent identity to an enclave whose MRENCLAVE measurement is authenticated by remote attestation and a hardware-rooted platform key. Software and keys can be duplicated in virtual machines, but a clone cannot forge valid silicon-backed evidence. Under a one-identity-per-attested-enclave policy, creating identities requires acquiring additional authorized physical hardware, not merely copying a VM; pulse, ledge, and beacon are protocol labels, not substitutes for attestation.
